title: Installation of Gondolas in High-rise Residential Developments
what_it_is: Installation of Gondolas in High-rise Residential Developments

sections.label: Gondola points and regulation
sections.summary: BCA does not regulate gondola systems or gondola point locations; developers provide them, and changes are contractual matters with developers and MCST.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: BCA does not regulate the use of gondola systems nor specify the location of gondola points to anchor the system.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Such gondola points or other building maintenance systems are provided by the developer to facilitate maintenance works on the building facade, such as cyclical maintenance, cleaning or repairs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: These gondola points are typically provided at the roof of the development and, in the case of some private residential developments, they may also be provided at the external wall, planter, air conditioner ledge, roof terrace, balcony of some of these units.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Developers will generally inform home buyers of the gondola points and the need for access through their Sale and Purchase Agreement.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Any request to change the gondola points or system is a contractual matter home buyers need to settle with the developer and, subsequently, the Management Corporation Strata Title (MCST).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The safety requirements for the erection and operation of gondolas are governed under MOM's Workplace Safety and Health Act.

sections.label: Singapore Mediation Centre and URA help
sections.summary: The Singapore Mediation Centre can help, and URA will facilitate by getting the developer to look seriously at residents' concerns.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: One institution that can help the process is the Singapore Mediation Centre (SMC).

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: If they approach URA, and some residents have done so, URA will facilitate by getting the developer to look seriously at the residents' concerns.
